A001_NO_ATTRIBUTION.summary: Lexicon marker path attributed zero tokens (L1 ATTRIBUTED_TOKENS==0) without documented fallback.

A002_UPSTREAM_NONZERO_DOWNSTREAM_ZERO.summary: Sealed concept/prior mass present but hex or family aggregate total mass collapsed to zero.

A003_THRESHOLD_OVERKILL.summary: Numeric values clipped or rounded away by thresholds while upstream signal exists.

A004_PROFILE_MISMATCH.summary: Calibration profile / registry expectation does not match emitted scale or field set.

A005_SCALE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION.summary: Value outside declared contract range for its semantic_type (see output_metric_registry_v1).

A006_READABILITY_LAYER_MISSING.summary: Readable band / display block absent for a metric that requires it under active profile.

A007_CROSS_PLANE_INCONSISTENCY.summary: Structural/sealed/analyze disagree beyond gold tolerance (coverage, mass, ranks).

G004_MISSING_BUNDLE_MANIFEST.summary: 00_manifest.json missing from bundle directory; cannot evaluate release gate (non-research profiles).
